author: Vincent Augerot
name: HardSlice query slice
description: A query slice of a hardslice-api solution: query, DTO, handler reading its aggregate without tracking, endpoint and integration tests. --route chooses the route of its endpoint, which answers GET. Run it from the root of the solution with --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj.

Module.description: The module of the slice, in PascalCase, such as Bookings: src/<App>/Features/<Module>/<Module>Module.cs must exist.

Aggregate.description: The aggregate that the query reads, in PascalCase, such as Booking: a type of namespace <App>.Domain.<Module>, whose Id property is a <Aggregate>Id that wraps a Guid Value.

Result.description: What the query returns: single (one DTO read by its id, null answered with 404, by default) or many (the list of the DTOs). Not list: dotnet new would read it as its list command.

choices.description: One DTO read by its id; an unknown id is answered with 404.

Route.description: The route of the endpoint under the group of the module, chosen after the resource it reads rather than the use case: lowercase words separated by hyphens, and route parameters between braces such as {id:guid}, separated by slashes, such as trips or {roomId:guid}/bookings, or / for the group itself. The name of the slice in kebab-case by default. With --result single, /{id:guid} follows it.

Method.description: The HTTP method of the endpoint: GET, the only method of a query, which only reads.

Accepted.value: (AppIsKnown && NameIsGiven && NameIsPascalCase && !NameHasSuffix && ModuleIsPascalCase && ModuleExists && AggregateIsPascalCase && RouteIsValid && !RouteHidesId && MethodIsGet)

postActions.description: Refuses a solution whose web project it cannot read.

manualInstructions.text: error: hardslice-query reads the application from its web project, which it could not evaluate. Run it from the root of the solution with --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj, once the solution is restored (after a first build or check), such as: dotnet new hardslice-query --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj --module <Module> --name <Name> --aggregate <Aggregate>. Nothing was created.
error: --name is required: the use case in PascalCase, without the Query suffix, such as --name ListRoomBookings. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --name 'QueryName' is not PascalCase: it names the slice folder, its namespace and its types, such as --name ListRoomBookings. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a name with the Query suffix.

manualInstructions.text: error: --name 'QueryName' ends with Query: pass the use case alone, the template names the query <Name>Query. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a module name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --module 'ModuleName' is not PascalCase: pass the name of an existing module, such as the folder of src/MyApp/Features/<Module>/. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a module that does not exist.

manualInstructions.text: error: module 'ModuleName' does not exist: src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/ModuleNameModule.cs was not found. Create the module first with dotnet new hardslice-module --project src/MyApp/MyApp.csproj --name ModuleName, then add the slice. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses an aggregate name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --aggregate 'AggregateName' is not PascalCase: pass the aggregate root that the query reads, a type of src/MyApp.Domain/<Module>/, such as --aggregate Booking. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a route that ASP.NET Core or the tests could not use.

manualInstructions.text: error: --route '/slice-route' is not a route of lowercase words separated by hyphens, and route parameters between braces such as {id:guid}, separated by slashes, such as --route trips or --route {roomId:guid}/bookings. Pass --route / for the group of the module itself. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a route that already holds the parameter that a single result appends.

manualInstructions.text: error: --route '/slice-route' holds a parameter id, which --result single appends to it as /{id:guid} to read the aggregate by its identifier. Remove it from --route, such as --route trips, or pass / for the group of the module. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a method other than GET.

manualInstructions.text: error: --method 'HttpMethodName' is not GET: a query only reads and answers GET. A use case that changes state is a command, generated with dotnet new hardslice-command, which takes --method POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE. Nothing was created.
